## KV cache efficiency

Allocator property, measured with a fake model, so it is hardware independent. 256 requests, 65,536 KV token slots (4096 blocks of 16), outputs around 128 tokens.

| Strategy | Slot utilization | KV waste | Resident seqs | Decoding seqs | Preemptions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| contiguous (reserve max_model_len) | 1.6% | 98.4% | 2.0 | 1.4 | 0 |
| contiguous (reserve prompt + max_tokens) | 48.0% | 52.0% | 54.6 | 14.2 | 0 |
| contiguous (reserve prompt + max_tokens) | 54.1% | 45.9% | 42.8 | 42.8 | 0 |
| paged, static batching | 98.7% | 1.3% | 63.7 | 16.0 | 0 |
| paged, continuous batching | 98.7% | 1.4% | 43.7 | 43.3 | 0 |

## Prefix caching

32 requests sharing a 512-token system prompt with a 128-token tail each.

| Metric | Cache off | Cache on | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| TTFT p50 | 20,118.2 ms | 7,267.7 ms | **2.8x faster** |
| TTFT p95 | 27,874.2 ms | 8,609.5 ms | **3.2x faster** |
| end-to-end p50 | 24.4 s | 8.5 s | **2.9x faster** |
| wall clock | 101.7 s | 35.0 s | **2.9x faster** |

Block hit ratio 77.5%.

## Chunked prefill

Four streams decoding while a 2,048-token prompt is injected mid-flight. The worst gap is what a user watching tokens appear actually feels; p95 over a few hundred samples hides a single long stall.

| Chunk size | ITL p50 | ITL p95 | Worst gap | Injected prompt TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2048 | 92 ms | 561 ms | **23,203 ms** | 23.81 s |
| 512 | 89 ms | 6,813 ms | **9,750 ms** | 23.63 s |
| 128 | 91 ms | 1,653 ms | **1,969 ms** | 24.69 s |
